notes: Unanswerable questions were drawn from traditions verified absent from the corpus (Arthurian, Mesopotamian, Mesoamerican, Japanese/Shinto). Norse and Egyptian mythology, named as example "outside" traditions in the spec, are in fact covered by this corpus (lore_chunks/138-144, 146-156 Hindu/Norse; 116-117 Egyptian) and were excluded from candidate traditions on that basis. Absence for all 8 unanswerable questions was verified two ways: grep across lore_chunks/*.md, and a live query against the built dense index (k=5) confirming no returned passage answers the question, recorded per-question in notes. The paraphrase review pass is complete: all 15 in-corpus questions flagged at containment >=0.50 by .scratch/rag-evaluation-harness/containment_check.py were hand-edited and re-scored below that threshold, verified still answerable from their source_document against the same target fact. Unanswerable questions were left untouched, because their notes record dense-index top-5 hits computed for those exact question strings and rewording would invalidate that verification.
